data.one_liner: In-app console for real-time log viewing across modules with custom plugins.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-app console UI for viewing and filtering real-time logs across different modules or micro-frontends in a Flutter application. Supports a draggable floating bubble interface and an extension system for additional diagnostics like network inspection, performance monitoring, and device info.
use_when: You need real-time log viewing inside the app for testers and developers
Your app uses a modular or micro-frontend architecture with isolated loggers
You want to inspect logs, errors, and custom extension metrics without external tooling
avoid_when: You only require standard console printing without an in-app UI
Production diagnostics without UI overlays are preferred
strengths: Unified history with tagging for micro-frontend or modular architectures
Extensible plugin/extension system for network, statistics, and device info
Includes a draggable floating bubble for quick console access
weaknesses: Adds UI elements and logging overhead directly into the application binary
Requires manual addition of loggers and registration of extensions
